description: This file implements the 'reflog' command for Git, providing subcommands such as show, list, exists, write, delete, drop, and expire. It manages reflog operations including expiration, deletion, and writing new entries, and references external files and functions related to reflog management.

methods.name: collect_reflog
methods.description: Collects reflog references from worktrees, avoiding duplicates for shared refs.

methods.name: expire_unreachable_callback
methods.description: Callback to set expiry for unreachable reflog entries based on timestamp.

methods.name: expire_total_callback
methods.description: Callback to set total expiry for reflog entries based on timestamp.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_show
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog show' subcommand, displaying reflog references.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_list
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog list' subcommand, listing all reflogs.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_expire
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog expire' subcommand, expiring reflog entries based on criteria.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_delete
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog delete' subcommand, deleting specified reflogs.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_exists
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog exists' subcommand, checking if a reflog exists.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_drop
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog drop' subcommand, dropping reflogs for references.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_write
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog write' subcommand, writing a new reflog entry.

methods.name: cmd_reflog
methods.description: Main function for 'reflog' command, dispatching to subcommands.
